label: photoferrotrophy
definition: An anoxygenic photosynthesis in which an organism uses light energy to oxidize Fe(II) as an electron donor for carbon fixation and biomass formation.
exact_synonyms: phototrophic Fe(II) oxidation|anoxygenic phototrophic Fe(II) oxidation
observations: Fe(II)-donor anoxygenic photosynthesis branch; absent from live METPO and represented in TraitMech as a subtype of both local anoxygenic photosynthesis and local iron oxidation.
